subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings -> Privacy adopt the proposed Location Sharing switch plus Access Level row as the intended iOS privacy UI contract?
rationale: The source issue is valid, but replacing a segmented permission control with a new visible control pattern is product/UX direction rather than a strict existing-behavior bug fix.

options.title: Review a narrow contributor PR
options.body: Accept the proposed direction in principle and ask for a focused PR that changes only the Privacy/Location card contract plus tests.

options.title: Fold into broader location design
options.body: Keep this as a subtask of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99229 if maintainers want one unified Always/background-location product decision first.

options.title: Keep the current segmented control
options.body: Close or redirect this request if maintainers prefer the current explicit three-mode picker despite the duplicate summary concern.

recommendation.title: Review a narrow contributor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed direction in principle and ask for a focused PR that changes only the Privacy/Location card contract plus tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS Privacy settings merger and current blame/history owner for the affected SettingsProTab surface.
